lead: An `ends-early` attack passes when *any* step ends the program, so the steps after it can stop running and nothing reports it.
body: `tools/dossier.py` accepts an ending anywhere in such a case, and `Core\Html::parse`'s attack hit its memory limit at step 2 of six, because every `var` from step 1 stayed alive, so steps 3 to 6 never ran. Run an `ends-early` case with `target/release/nvs.exe run <file>` once and check that the last `step N:` line printed is the one the comment says ends it.
